title: Move to the published quest/lore 0.13.0 pair
description: Move the repository from the published quest/lore 0.12.0 pair to 0.13.0. Regenerate .lore/schemas/ with 'lore schema export' under 0.13.0, bump the lore CI pin (LORE_VERSION in .github/workflows/ci.yml) to 0.13.0, regenerate the managed Quest block with the installed 0.13.0 CLI (routine managed-block carve-out) so CLAUDE.md declares Quest CLI 0.13.0, and refresh the lore agent bridge where it applies. Schemas and pin land together (LCLI-690). Land via a pull request with the required checks green, then promote dev to main. Requested by the orchestrator via team-lead, OPAG-1258, 2026-10-08 (operator ruling 'Move the 9 repos now', relayed by opum-doc, answered first-party ~17:40Z 2026-10-08).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The .lore/schemas/ JSON Schemas are regenerated by lore schema export under lore 0.13.0 and are committed in the same change as the CI pin bump (schemas and pin land together, LCLI-690).
The managed Quest block in CLAUDE.md declares Quest CLI 0.13.0, and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude reports current in the Tracker integrity job on the PR head SHA.
The Docs job on the PR head SHA resolves lore 0.13.0 (log line Resolved lore version: 0.13.0), with lore agents --check, lore validate --strict and lore check --strict all green in that job.
The required contexts (Docs, Tracker integrity, Check) are all green on the PR head SHA.
A bare lore check exits 0 locally under the global lore 0.13.0.

plan: 2. Run lore schema export under 0.13.0 to regenerate .lore/schemas/.

3. Bump LORE_VERSION in .github/workflows/ci.yml to 0.13.0, and regenerate the managed Quest block with quest agents --update-instructions --target claude so CLAUDE.md declares Quest CLI 0.13.0. Refresh the lore agent bridge with lore agents.
4. Validate locally under global 0.13.0 (bare lore check, lore validate --strict, lore agents --check, quest agents --check, bun run check); commit and open the PR into dev.
5. With the required contexts green on the head SHA, check the acceptance criteria against that run, close GCLI-8 in the PR, and merge.
6. Promote dev to main, read the refs back, and report to team-lead.
